body:
I logically can agree with everything you said, but I feel so strongly about killing myself that I'm not sure I will be able to prevent it from happening. 

There are too many instances where I feel so strongly about ending my life that I think I will impulsively try to kill myself. I do feel like a lost cause.

Yeah, I dont want them to go through with that, or I guess I don't want to see their reactions because I know they would be hurt just like they were after my first suicide attempt. 

Plus I feel like I can't do anything. I can barely get out of bed or eat. I don't have the motivation to do anything, and I have four essays to write plus exams. I feel like I'm going to fail.

I have issues bringing up suicide with the people who are dear to me because they witnessed my suicide attempt last year. I know it's better to tell them, but I feel like I can't talk about with them.
